info.name: Single Point — MVP-1 … MVP-7
info.description:
End-to-end walkthrough of the MVP-1 API: resident onboarding, ticket lifecycle, admin triage, provider workflow, super-admin onboarding.

Run the requests top to bottom the first time — each folder's scripts capture the tokens / ids the next requests need into collection variables.

Local defaults: backend on http://localhost:18080, dev OTP mode ON (the code is returned in `devCode`).

request.description: Set `inviteCode` from the backend startup banner (or the Admin > Create invite code request). Leave it blank to submit a join request for admin approval instead.

item.name: Device binding · verify OTP on this device

request.description: X-Device-Id is optional but, when sent, gets baked into the minted token's deviceId claim.

item.name: Device binding · call with the matching device

request.description: Succeeds — the header matches the token's claim.

item.name: Device binding · call with no / a different device → 401

request.description: A token minted with a deviceId claim is rejected (SP-401-DEVICE) when the header is missing or different — the client falls back to a fresh OTP sign-in, which binds a new token to this device. A token with no claim (no header was ever sent) is never gated.

item.name: Device binding · refresh preserves the binding

request.description: The re-minted token is still bound to the same device.

item.name: Super Admin · set community lifecycle status

request.description: ACTIVE / SUSPENDED / ARCHIVED. PENDING_REVIEW is rejected (400 SP-400) — that transition only happens through the onboarding approve/reject flow.

On the management port (18081), no app JWT. Carries http_server_requests_seconds, hikaricp_*, jvm_*, and sp_tickets_raised_total / sp_offers_redeemed_total / sp_broadcasts_sent_total / sp_communities_self_onboarded_total, all tagged application="single-point".
Store a gateway payment token the client obtained from Razorpay Checkout. The stub gateway accepts any string. brand/last4 are display-only.
The caller's own saved methods, newest first; REMOVED ones are excluded.
Soft-removes the method (status REMOVED). A live gateway subscription keeps charging until the plan is cancelled.
effectivePlan + subscription. With a saved payment method on a paid plan the view carries savedPaymentMethod, recurring=true and nextChargeAt; RESIDENT subjects resolve to RESIDENT_FREE.

Assign or switch plan for the caller's subject (TENANT admin / PROVIDER / RESIDENT). Paid->paid mid-period computes an unused-days proration credit against the next invoice. With a saved payment method the gateway subscription drives activation; without one it falls back to a pay link. RESIDENT self-upgrade is 400 SP-400-VALIDATION until a paid resident plan exists.
Non-cloud only. Posts a signed synthetic subscription.charged webhook for the gateway subscription id, settling the period invoice and activating the subscription. No app JWT.

item.name: Dev · post a subscription webhook event

request.description: Non-cloud only. Replace the path segment with subscription.charged / subscription.halted / subscription.cancelled to drive the subscription state machine. subscription.halted -> PAST_DUE + grace.
The caller's own PUSH-channel notifications, newest first. unreadOnly=true filters to unread. Each row: id, template, title, body, data, createdAt, readAt.
{ count } of unread PUSH notifications. MeResponse.unreadNotifications carries the same number on cold start.
Stamps read_at on one of the caller's own notifications. 404 if it isn't theirs. Idempotent.
Stamps read_at on every unread PUSH notification for the caller; returns the count updated.

promoWhatsappEnabled is opt-IN (default false); a promo offer reaches WhatsApp only when it is true AND the community holds WHATSAPP_NOTIFICATIONS AND the weekly promo cap is clear. Other fields unchanged from MVP-6/9.

Omit scheduledFor (or set it in the past) to send now. A future scheduledFor persists the row PENDING with recipientCount 0 and no outbox fan-out; BroadcastDispatchJob sends it when due. The 60s cooldown + 20/day cap are checked at schedule time.
Cancels a PENDING scheduled broadcast (status CANCELLED). 409 SP-409 if already SENT; 403 if the caller isn't the sender or a Super Admin.
Same scheduling semantics as the admin route. scope ALL_ADMINS / ALL_USERS / COMMUNITY (tenantId required for COMMUNITY).

item.name: Super Admin · cancel a pending broadcast

request.description: Cancels a PENDING scheduled broadcast. 409 SP-409 once SENT.

application/json attachment single-point-export-<date>.json: profile, memberships, ticketsRaised (+ statusHistory, payments, receipts), offerRedemptions, offerFeedback, notifications, devices - the caller's own rows across every community.

Soft-delete + anonymize: 204 on success. 409 SP-409 while the caller has open (non-CLOSED) tickets, unsettled ticket payments, or is the sole active admin of a community. On success: EXIT all memberships, scrub name/email/phone(_hash), set deleted_at, drop device_token + payment_method rows. The old JWT then 401s SP-401 and the phone number frees for a fresh signup.
Sessions recorded on sign-in, newest last-seen first: id, label, platform, lastSeenAt, current (matches the caller's own deviceId claim), revoked.
Stamps revoked_at. That device's next request with a deviceId-bearing token gets 401 SP-401-DEVICE "this device was signed out".
